elements.costPerUnitDistance: Per-mile (or per-km) vehicle cost: fuel, maintenance, insurance, depreciation. The IRS standard business mileage rate is offered as a documented PROXY - it is a tax rate for business driving, not an official measure of personal commuting cost. Users can always enter their own figure.
elements.hourlyValue: The user's subjective value of an hour of personal time. Not a market rate; the calculator makes the assumption explicit.
elements.weeksPerYear: Commuting weeks, typically 46-48 after vacation and holidays.
elements.parkingAndTollsPerDay: Total round-trip parking and tolls per commute day, excluding vehicle mileage costs.

constraints: totalAnnualCost must be non-decreasing in costPerUnitDistance, distance, time, days, and weeks.
Any per-mile rate quoted in definition text or presets must match a value in sources below.
The tool's registry updatedAt must not be newer than this model's reviewedAt.

sources.name: IRS standard mileage rate, business use, Jan 1 - Jun 30 2026
IRS standard mileage rate, business use, Jul 1 - Dec 31 2026
